card.name: Leading digit 5, 6 or 7 in numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit (usually 5, 6 or 7) of a multi-digit number, mostly in a denominator, section number or code reference. It also fires on a few odd spots such as the t in Sixtus.

modes.label: Denominator digit
modes.description: A leading digit of the total in a patient count fraction such as (204/503).

modes.label: Section or bill number
modes.description: A leading digit in a legal section, bill or publication number.
modes.example: AIDS discrimination is prohibited under Section <<5>>04 of this Act.

modes.label: Name or comma oddities
modes.description: Occasional hits on a letter inside a name or a thousands comma, unrelated to dosing.
modes.example: Six<<t>>us V wished the struggle against heresy

card.plain: It lights up on the first digit of a number that is still being written, such as a patient total or a section number.
